evidence.title: Shadcn UI Templates for Next.js, Laravel, Vite and Astro - ReUI

name: Shadcn UI Templates for Next.js, Laravel, Vite and Astro
summary: 17 full-page shadcn/ui templates for Next.js, Laravel, TanStack Start, React Router, Astro and Vite.
description: Complete multi-page app projects built from the ReUI registry's components and blocks: SaaS marketing sites, dashboards, CRMs, admin consoles, a help desk, HR, commerce and cloud storage apps. Each downloads as a standalone project for one framework, with app shell, auth, dashboard, profile and settings, and onboarding already wired.
contains: 17 full-page templates: SaaS 8, dashboard 5, landing 2, e-commerce 2
frameworks: Next.js, Vite, TanStack Start, React Router, Astro, Laravel with Inertia
each ships an app shell, auth suite, dashboard, profile and settings, onboarding
downloaded as a full standalone project, not a shadcn registry item
free templates need an account; the rest come with the Ultimate plan from $249 once
commercial use allowed in own and client products
an MCP server lets coding agents search the registry and extend a template
